seeded_failure.symptom: Tapping the Floating Action Button throws an IllegalStateException and crashes the app when showing a Snackbar.
seeded_failure.cause: The coroutine scope used to launch snackbarHostState.showSnackbar is called directly inside a composable function body instead of an event handler or remembered coroutine scope.
seeded_failure.fix: Obtain a scope with rememberCoroutineScope() and launch showSnackbar inside the FAB onClick event handler.
